name: tool-repetition-retry-after-failure
description: Same tool, same arguments, three transient FAILURES then a success. Must never trip: a retry after a failure is recovery, not a loop, and the success that follows must not be punished for the failures before it. Runaway FAILING tools are the zombie circuit breaker's job (tools.agent.zombie_threshold), which is also why this trace is not replayed at the loop tier — three consecutive failed iterations trip that breaker by design.
